test_describe_mixed_frame: test DataFrame.describe() on a mixed frame with bool, string, and integer columns
test_describe_categorical: test DataFrame.describe() on categorical columns and compare with string array output
test_describe_percentiles: test DataFrame.describe() with custom percentiles argument for percentile-based statistics
test_describe_include_exclude: test DataFrame.describe() with include and exclude parameters for specific dtypes
test_describe_empty_columns: test DataFrame.describe() on empty DataFrames and empty categorical columns
